about: Answer key for tests/fixtures/demo-vault (CON-012, UX-008, Ch.9.6.2, Ch.16.5.7). The vault is fictional sample data: Nimbrel Studio and its product Quillwend do not exist, and every person in it is invented. Paths are relative to the vault root. Kept outside the vault on purpose: a key inside it would be indexed and would hand the assistant the answers. tests/test_demo_vault.py checks every fact below against the files.

name_check.how: Exact-phrase web searches for each name returned no business, product or person using it (only look-alikes such as Nimble/Nimbl studios and Tessalon). They replace the vault's first names, which collided with a real content studio, a person's Instagram handle, a WordPress theme and a publisher (demo-vault review F4; the retired names are listed in tests/test_demo_vault.py so they cannot come back). Re-check before a recorded demo is published.

questions.question: Which two documents disagree about the launch date, and what does each say?
questions.correct_answer: The launch plan (Maya, 2026-09-14) says Tuesday 3 November 2026; the press kit draft (Jonah, 2026-09-02) says 17 November 2026.

questions.question: What is the per-device request limit of the Quillwend sync API?
questions.correct_answer: 120 requests per minute per device (600 per account).

questions.question: What did we finally decide about annual pricing, and when did it change?
questions.correct_answer: A flat 25% annual discount on every plan (Solo $54 per year, Team $135 per seat per year), decided at the 2026-08-19 pricing review and written up as final in pricing v3 on 2026-09-08. It replaced v1's 'two months free' ($60 per year, June).

questions.question: What caused the duplicate entries incident in September?
questions.correct_answer: Device clock skew: deduplication used wall-clock timestamps, so devices with clocks more than 90 seconds apart kept the same check-in twice. Fixed in build 0.9.7 (event IDs plus Lamport clocks).

questions.question: What did people ask for most in the user interviews?
questions.correct_answer: Shared streaks with a small private group (7 of 12 participants).

questions.question: How quickly are approved refunds paid back?
questions.correct_answer: Within 5 business days, to the original payment method (refunds can be requested within 30 days of a payment).

exclusive_facts.why: Q1 must have exactly two answers: no other file may state a November 2026 date.
D1: the old annual Solo price appears only in v1 and in the two documents that say it changed.
D1: the new annual Solo price appears only in the decision and in v3.
S3: the refund payout time is only in the DOCX, so a correct answer proves DOCX parsing.
S2: the interview count is only in the PDF, so a correct answer proves PDF parsing.
